display.label: Bastion Host
display.description: Azure Bastion Host provides secure and seamless RDP/SSH access to virtual machines directly over SSL without exposing public IPs

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Bastion Host. Serves as the map key.

fields.label: Bastion Host Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Bastion Host. Must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, underscores, hyphens, or periods.

validation.pattern_error: Bastion Host name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, underscores, hyphens, or periods.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Bastion Host.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Bastion Host should be created.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: The SKU tier of the Bastion Host. Standard enables scaling, native client tunneling, and file copy. Premium enables session recording.

options.label: Standard (Adds Native Client, File Copy, Scaling)

fields.label: Scale Units
fields.description: The number of scale units for the Bastion Host (between 2 and 50). Fixed at 2 for Basic SKU.

sections.label: Networking & IP Configuration
sections.description: Network configuration linking the Bastion Host to AzureBastionSubnet.

fields.label: IP Configuration
fields.description: Network IP configuration block for the Bastion Host.

fields.label: Bastion Subnet ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the subnet. Must be named AzureBastionSubnet with at least a /26 CIDR prefix.

fields.label: Public IP Address ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the Standard SKU Static Public IP address for the Bastion Host.

fields.label: Availability Zones
fields.description: List of Availability Zones in which the Bastion Host should be located (e.g. 1, 2, 3).

sections.label: Bastion Features
sections.description: Feature toggles for Azure Bastion Host capabilities.

fields.label: Copy / Paste Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether the Copy/Paste feature is enabled for the Bastion Host.

fields.label: File Copy Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether File Copy is enabled. Supported on Standard and Premium SKUs.

fields.label: Shareable Link Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether Shareable Links are enabled. Supported on Standard and Premium SKUs.

fields.label: Native Client Tunneling Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether Native Client Tunneling is enabled (e.g. connecting via native SSH/RDP clients). Supported on Standard and Premium SKUs.

fields.label: IP Connect Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether IP Connect is enabled to connect directly via IP. Supported on Standard and Premium SKUs.

fields.label: Session Recording Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether Session Recording is enabled. Only supported on Premium SKU.

fields.label: Kerberos Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether Kerberos authentication is enabled. Supported on Standard and Premium SKUs.

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the Bastion Host.
